_howto: Hosting partners. affiliate:true means url is a real referral link and refParam is appended to deep links (data/deploy-links.json); those links get rel=sponsored and count toward the affiliate disclosure. affiliate:false partners are plain helpful links. managed:true puts the partner in the 'No server to run it on?' box on category pages, in the listed order. Verified program terms: see notes. Research date 2026-10-14.
_rule: Only relevant offers: hosting or deployment of open-source apps. Do not add the proprietary SaaS itself or unrelated banners; they do not convert and they cost trust and rankings.
